_doc: Sync provenance for a project forked from the AI Coding Starter. /maintain:sync-from-starter reads `last_sync_commit` as the merge base for its 3-way comparison and rewrites this file after a successful sync. In the STARTER ITSELF every field stays null/default — the starter is upstream and has no parent; the file ships so a fresh fork has the shape already present instead of the sync command guessing a base. In the starter itself `excluded` stays empty.
_excluded_doc: Repo-relative paths pruned by /setup:start (directories end with `/`). /maintain:sync-from-starter never creates a task for them and skips the matching .mcp.json / settings.json entries per .claude/project-profile.json; remove a path here to have sync re-offer it.
